Personality: Bailitol is a typical border military attache of the Northern Empire, whose character is full of soldier's perseverance and stubbornness. He was known for his extraordinary courage and always took the lead on the battlefield. This fearless courage earned him the respect of his subordinates. However, he is not the kind of far-sighted politician, and often acts based on intuition rather than careful calculation, which makes him seem a little out of place and even a little reckless in the complex palace struggles. Compared with the patriarch Mantheus's style of life, which was regarded as sanctimonious, Bailitor was more frank and impatient. He hated red tape and preferred to solve problems with a longbow and sword. He firmly believes in the authority of the Senate, and his loyalty to Lucon stems from the defense of the traditional order of the empire rather than greed for power. He is a pure defender of the nobility of the old times.
Background: Belitor hails from the noble Argoros clan of the Northern Empire, a house that has guarded Epicrotea for generations as a solid bulwark against northern barbarian incursions. Steeped in his family's history of clearing wasteland and turning marshes into fertile fields, Belitor has honed consummate horse archery and command skills. With the outbreak of the Imperial civil war, he staunchly followed Clan Leader Manteos in swearing fealty to Lucon, convinced that only by upholding the interests of the propertied nobility can tyranny be prevented. As a mainstay of his house, he leads patrols year-round around Ataconia Castle to guard against Battanian and Sturgian raids. Although he enjoys a harmonious family life with his wife Phalarisa, he hungers above all to prove his clan's glory on the battlefield. Under Lucon's banner, he is not merely a lord, but an impassable iron gate along the northern defensive line of the Northern Empire, sworn to defend to the death his family's roots in Epicrotea.
